# SpinQ

> SpinQ is a quantum computing company offering practical quantum computers, cloud platforms, and software solutions across superconducting and NMR technologies for education, finance, biomedicine, and AI applications.

SpinQ develops both superconducting and NMR quantum computers with cloud platforms and software tools, serving enterprises and educational institutions globally. The company focuses on making quantum computing accessible through hands-on learning systems and industry-specific solutions.

## Key Topics

- SpinQ Gemini Lab
- Superconducting Quantum Computers
- NMR Quantum Computers
- SPINQ Cloud Platform
- Quantum Education
- Quantum Hardware
- Quantum Algorithms
- QPU (Quantum Processing Unit)
- Quantum Programming
- Josephson Junctions
- Grover's Algorithm
- Quantum Finance Solutions
- Quantum Biomedicine
- Quantum AI/ML
- Hands-on Learning

## Quantum Hardware Products

- [Superconducting Quantum Computers & Chips Provider](https://www.spinquanta.com/products/superconducting-quantum-products): SpinQ superconducting quantum computers, chips, and QPU foundry services.
- [NMR Quantum Computers for Education](https://www.spinquanta.com/products/nmr-quantum-products): SpinQ NMR quantum computers: Gemini Lab, Mini, Mini Pro, and Triangulum II for accessible quantum learning.

## Quantum Software & Cloud Platform

- [Quantum Computing Cloud Platform & Software](https://www.spinquanta.com/products/quantum-computing-software): SPINQ Cloud, QEDA, and SpinQit quantum software and programming platform.

## Industry Solutions

- [Quantum Computing Solutions for Quantum Education](https://www.spinquanta.com/quantum-computing-solutions/education): SpinQ quantum education solutions for universities, K-12, and research institutes.
- [Quantum Computing Solutions for Finance](https://www.spinquanta.com/quantum-computing-solutions/finance): SpinQ quantum computing for fintech: portfolio optimization and risk assessment.
- [Quantum Computing Solutions for Biomedicine](https://www.spinquanta.com/quantum-computing-solutions/biomedince): SpinQ quantum solutions for drug development and biomedical simulations.
- [Quantum Computing Solutions for AI](https://www.spinquanta.com/quantum-computing-solutions/artificial-intelligence): SpinQ quantum computing for AI, machine learning, and NLP applications.
